description: Zero-Trust Agentic Guard: Sanitizes an array of document chunks or knowledge base records before sending to embedding models or vector databases (Chroma, Pinecone, Qdrant). Keeps authentic data in local RAM with zero network leakage.

chunks.description: Array of chunk objects ({ id?: string, text: string, metadata?: object }) or array of chunk strings to sanitize.

profile.description: The detection profile to use. Defaults to 'General'.

session_id.description: Optional session ID for isolated multi-task agent memory. Defaults to 'default'.

name: guard_rag_chunk
